note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own, as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them before this guide was written; the two agree on every name, description and grade. Guides are this guide's own words, written from the official descriptions. The game released 19 November 2026, so no guide step here has been checked in the game yet: where a step is not pinned down, the guide says so. PSN rarity figures are PSNProfiles' PSN column as read 19 November 2026 (launch day) and will move as more players earn each trophy.

own.label: Our own advice — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, and there is no separate task behind it. Work the roadmap in order and this one takes care of itself. It is a long haul — outside estimates put the full list near 200 hours, and the 100% completion gold is the biggest single chunk of it — so treat the platinum as the finish line of the whole guide, not a trophy to chase on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission — it is the first mission of the story, so this is the first trophy most players will earn, and it is hidden on PlayStation until it pops. No preparation is needed; just play the story from the start and tick it off as soon as the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. This is an unmissable story trophy — keep playing the main story and it pops when the chapter closes. Do one thing before you leave Chapter 1, though: meditate at the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude, the one trophy in the game reported as possibly missable. The chapter itself cannot be missed; the meditation spot might be.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Unmissable story trophy; it pops when the chapter ends. Chapter 2 is where both protagonists become playable and most of the map's side content opens up, so it is a good moment to start the collectible and activity trophies in the roadmap's later stages instead of leaving them all for after the credits.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Unmissable story trophy; it pops when the chapter ends. By now the side strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret are opening up — take their missions between story chapters so the character trophies do not all pile up at the end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Unmissable story trophy; it pops when the chapter ends. One chapter left after this one, so use the gap to clear any character strands and activities that are available before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This gold is unmissable — finish the story and it is yours. The platinum is still a long way off at this point: most of the list is side content, so use the roadmap's cleanup stages after the credits rather than expecting the story alone to carry you to the platinum.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a named story mission. Unmissable if you play the story: it pops when the mission ends, with no extra objective to meet.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a named story mission. Unmissable: play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops. It is one of the story's big set-pieces, so expect a longer mission than the chapter trophies around it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a named story mission. Unmissable: it pops when the mission ends. No preparation or side objective is needed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a named story mission. Unmissable: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a named story mission at Vice City International Airport. Unmissable: it pops when the mission ends. The airport is also the setting for Catch Me If You Can, so the area will feel familiar when you come back for that one.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a named story mission. Unmissable: it pops when the mission ends. With this, the twelve story trophies are all earned by finishing the campaign — none of them can be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the gold that decides the platinum, and the last trophy most players will earn. The in-game Progress menu, available after the story, shows the checklist itself, and that menu is the authority: work from it, not from any outside list. Outside reports say the checklist asks for a share of each category rather than literally everything — for example 70 of the 80 challenges and the 42 shooting-range gold medals — but the exact list is the game's own. Nearly every other trophy feeds into it, so chase it last and let the rest of the list do the work.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's stunt jumps and air tricks — PSN tracks them 0/250. Do them as you travel rather than in one grind: any jump that counts adds to the total across the whole playthrough. There is no known shortcut; it is a volume trophy, so start early and let it accumulate while you do everything else.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. PSN counts 9 activity types (0/9): play one of each — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone races and the rest — and it pops. Use the roadmap's activity stage to tick the types off one by one; the game itself is the authority on what counts as a type, so if one type is unclear, try the activity and watch the counter.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. PSN tracks 42 challenges (0/42). Gold each one — this is the list's hardest skill trophy, so expect to replay ranges and learn each course.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. PSN tracks 14 locations (0/14). Win one race at each of the 14 drone-race spots. Learn a track before racing it for the win; a loss costs nothing but time, and you can retry a location as often as you like.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PSN tracks 20 (0/20). Twenty distinct race events — repeats of the same race do not count twice. Mix race types as you go; the roadmap's activity stage lists them alongside the drone races so you can clear both in the same sessions.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activity types for Master of None, so this pairs with that trophy. No location is pinned down yet — the challenge is found by playing, not from a map marker we can verify — so take the fishing rod out whenever the game offers it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade game through to its end. Arcades are found in the open world; one full playthrough is all it takes, and it counts as an activity type for Master of None too.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's strand of side missions — it is hidden on PlayStation until earned, so the game will not tell you it exists until it pops. Character strands unlock as the story progresses; keep returning to Andy's missions between story chapters rather than saving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's strand of side missions. Like the other character finales, it is hidden until earned and it counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, so it does double duty.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand of side missions. Hidden until earned; it also counts as one of the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. PSN tracks 8 (0/8). There are more stranger strands than the eight needed, so pick the eight you enjoy — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret all have strands that count toward this as well as their own trophies, so the character finales in the roadmap's third stage cover most of it on their own.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand of side missions. Hidden until earned; it also counts as one of the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand of side missions. Hidden until earned; it also counts as one of the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. PSN tracks 18 spots (0/18). WARNING — THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: guides report that one meditation spot, Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1, disappears after that chapter, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends and keep a manual save from Chapter 1 as insurance until the trophy pops. For the other spots, work through them in free roam after the story; the count is tracked, so you can see how many remain.
trophies.missable_note: One meditation spot is reported to be Chapter 1 only (Lucia's balcony). Meditate there before Chapter 1 ends; keep a manual Chapter 1 save as insurance.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Finish Bret's hunting strand and take down the unique animal it asks for. Outside guides describe Bret's strand as Jason-only, with hunts chosen from target decks — treat that as a lead to check in the game, not a confirmed fact, since no source we can verify pins the animal down yet. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned, and it counts as one of the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. PSN tracks 3 sets (0/3). Cards are a collectible found across Leonida; a set completes when every card in it is found. Track the sets in the counter here and sweep one region at a time so you do not re-cover ground you have already cleared.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. PSN tracks 100 (0/100). Use the WAiNK app at 100 different spots — it is a volume collectible, so scan as you travel and the count climbs on its own. Pair it with the exploration sweep for The Goodtime State: every new area you visit is a new place to scan.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. PSN tracks 50 (0/50). Challenges are the game's small objectives; 50 of the 80 count here, and 70 of 80 feed the 100% checklist, so every challenge you finish works twice. Do not grind them first — let them accumulate while you play the rest of the list, then mop up the remainder at the end.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search until the wanted level clears. Open ground and a fast car help; do it away from chokepoints where the police can corner you, and do not let your partner get separated from you mid-escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive the whole time — do not let it clear between shops, and do not get caught. Plan a route of three close shops before you start, and move fast between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. PSN tracks 100 (0/100). Drive or enter 100 different vehicles; new models count, repeats do not. Variety is the strategy — try everything you see rather than sticking to one car — and it pairs with On the Spot, which wants ten of those vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends. A crowded fight is the place to try; missing one means trying again, not failing the trophy, so pick a fight with plenty of targets and room to move.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get an aircraft off the ground at Vice City International Airport without going through the usual channels — take one from the airport and take off. Hidden on PlayStation until earned; expect a wanted level on the way out, and pick a runway with a clear climb-out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Take a Rhino tank and meet its hidden combat requirement — the description is deliberately vague, and the exact trigger is not pinned down yet. Experiment with the tank's cannon against targets and vehicles; this is one of the trophies whose precise method the community is still establishing, so treat any specific number you read elsewhere as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get in and out of a jewelry store unnoticed — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Go quiet, go at a quiet hour, and leave before anyone notices. If you are spotted, leave and try again rather than fighting your way out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. PSN tracks 5 (0/5). Five vault robberies, each followed by a clean escape. These are the big heists of the robbery set — plan the getaway before the robbery, and count each one off here so you know how many vaults remain.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road and get away clean. Trucks run routes through the city; pick a quiet stretch for the hit, with an escape route already in mind before you strike.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PSN tracks 52 areas (0/52). Visit all 52 map areas — drive, fly and walk the map until every region registers. It pairs naturally with the collectible sweeps, so do them together: every area you visit for cards, WAiNK scans or meditation spots counts here too.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. PSN tracks 9 gangs (0/9). One illegal operation per gang, nine in all. Each gang's operation is a different spot, so this is a tour of the underworld as much as a robbery list — work through the gangs one by one and tick them off in the counter.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Order a cocktail at a bar with an Ocean Beach view and enjoy it. A quiet one — no combat needed, just the right spot. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned, and it is one of the quickest trophies on the list once you know where the bar is.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a vehicle showroom's front in classic style — pick a fast car, aim at the glass, and go. Hidden on PlayStation until earned; the showroom will not thank you, and the wanted level that follows is part of the fun.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through — complete the bowling action the trophy asks for. It pairs with Ten Pin, the melee drive-by at the same alley, so visit the alley once and try for both.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength to maximum, as outside guides report — the official description gives no number, so treat the Strength reading as a lead to check in the game: train both characters' Strength and watch for the pop. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, per PSN's 0/500 counter. It is a volume trophy — everything that moves your criminal profile counts, so it climbs as you play the rest of the list. Do not grind it first; let it accumulate, and check the counter here near the end.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trigger is a hidden second-chance event whose exact method is still unverified — the official description is all we have. Keep playing; story and side content may trigger it on their own. If it has not popped by the cleanup stage, it is one to watch community reports for, not to force.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden encounter whose trigger is still unverified. Explore odd corners of Leonida and follow anything strange — this is the list's mystery trophy, and its method is not yet established by any source we can verify. Do not let it block the rest of the list; it will either pop on its own or become clear as players map the game.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Perform a melee drive-by at the bowling alley — strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. The precise conditions are still being established, so pair the attempt with Let's Go Bowling at the same alley and treat any specific method you read elsewhere as unconfirmed until players verify it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. PSN tracks $250,000 (0/250000). Launder marked bills through contacts until the total hits $250k — it accumulates across the playthrough, so keep laundering as you earn rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. PSN tracks $100,000 (0/100000). Spend across shops — clothes, food, gear — until the total clears $100k. It counts all shops, so normal spending plus the big purchases add up; the garage properties for Little Boxes also help if they count as shop spending, but do not rely on that.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. PSN tracks 8 (0/8). Buy all eight garage properties. Save it for when money is plentiful late in the game; garages also give you somewhere to keep the vehicles for Whip It Good and On the Spot, so buy them before the final vehicle sweep.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. PSN tracks 10 (0/10). Register ten vehicles you own or find through the Scooter Bros app — a quick one once you have vehicles to register, and a natural finish to the vehicle trophies after Whip It Good.
trophies.name: On the Spot
